THE CALCULATION

How the planner works

Choose an assignment type

The selector covers all 117 task types in the supplied workbook. A representative monster estimates kill time; variants such as Basilisk Knights use the Basilisks assignment. Update HP and the DPS multiplier to model a different variant.

Block for assignment chance

Exclude unmet Slayer levels and your manual requirement exclusions. Block the highest remaining weights, breaking ties by longer duration and then task name. The selected target is never blocked or skipped. Each master has its own suggested block list; these are alternative plans.

The workbook allocates no block slots to Turael / Aya, Spria, Krystilia or Mazchna / Achtryn. This app preserves that assumption.

Estimate the time

Kill seconds = HP ÷ (effective DPS × creature multiplier) + delay

Task minutes use the mean assignment quantity, plus travel and banking. Waiting time is the expected time spent on non-target offers divided by the target probability. It stops at the offer, before completing your target task. Expected offers include the successful offer.

Keep skips sustainable

Skip the longest non-target tasks first. Spend only the points funded by long-run completions, including future target tasks. A fractional boundary task is skipped on the stated percentage of its appearances. The points balance describes repeated play, not a guarantee you can afford every skip from your current balance.

Ordinary masters charge 30 points per skip. Optional streak bonuses multiply base rewards by 1.775; diary bonuses are not included. A long target task can fund more skips over repeated cycles even though its completion time is outside the waiting estimate.

Mortimer offers

Model two or three distinct weighted draws without replacement. Choose your target whenever present, otherwise choose the shortest task. Reroll the offer according to that task’s skip frequency. Mortimer skips cost 100 points; rewards use each task’s mean point modifier multiplied by the editable modifier chance (20% by default). The three-choice option is a separate unlock scenario.

Data and assumptions

Assignment weights, quantities, shared exclusions and HP values come from the supplied workbook snapshot on 19 November 2026. These values have not been independently refreshed against current game tables. Quest and combat access not explicitly excluded is assumed satisfied. DPS and delays are estimates; the Slayer cape repeat effect is not modelled.
